_readme: Send either this object or a bare array of the `cases` entries.
WHAT THIS CORPUS IS FOR: it is the only thing that lets the authenticity eval
gate pass. Until it exists the gate reports every prompt version as ungated,
the prompt cannot be narrowed, and the buyer-facing positioning stays blocked.
THE ONE RULE THAT MATTERS: a brand needs BOTH authentic and counterfeit
examples. A brand with only genuine cases scores perfectly and proves nothing,
because the error the gate exists to catch — a known fake called authentic —
cannot occur. The import warns you about this per brand; it does not reject.
IMAGES: storage paths in the submission-images bucket, not URLs. The eval
replays them through the real authenticity pass, so they should be the same
kind of photos a seller would submit — including a macro frame (serial /
marking) where the tell depends on one.
PROVENANCE: source_url records WHO determined the label and how. A label with
no stated provenance is the weak kind, and it is audited on write.
PARTIAL SUCCESS: a malformed row is rejected and named by its index; the rest
still import. The response always carries `rejected` and an `errors` array.
